summary: The note describes Wesley Brethren Church, a historic church located in Wesley, Texas, United States. It states the church was built in 1866 and recognizes its historic status through two designations. It was named a Recorded Texas Historic Landmark in 1966 and listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1979.
one_line: Wesley Brethren Church is an 1866 historic church in Wesley, Texas, designated a Recorded Texas Historic Landmark in 1966 and listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1979.
